---
title: "Quality of life — primary preparation"
subtitle: "Six-month death-inclusive ordinal endpoint"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

Dedicated `baseline_q30` values take priority. Only when that field is missing
is the closest longitudinal Q30 within 14 days before or after `date_visit`
used as baseline. The landmark response is the latest remaining post-baseline
Q30 through day 182. Participants who died by day 182 are assigned state 8,
irrespective of an earlier questionnaire. Participants censored before day 182
retain an unknown composite endpoint until vital status is drawn in the
imputation stage. Among participants known or drawn to be alive, a missing
living QoL response is imputed with MICE.

States 1–7 run from best to worst QoL; state 8 is death.

```{r}
#| label: prepare-primary-qol-landmark
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
cohort_path <- here::here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
qol_path <- here::here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-qol.parquet")
output_dir <- here::here("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life")
output_path <- file.path(output_dir, "prepared.parquet")
longitudinal_path <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "death-inclusive-longitudinal-prepared.parquet"
)

cohort <- arrow::read_parquet(cohort_path) |>
  as.data.frame()
qol <- arrow::read_parquet(qol_path) |>
  as.data.frame()

required_cohort <- c(
  "id", "tx", "age", "gender", "diagnosis", "ecog_fstcnt",
  "stage_binary", "baseline_q30", "event_death", "survival_time_days"
)
required_qol <- c("id", "assessment_id", "questionnaire_date", "day", "q30")
if (!all(required_cohort %in% names(cohort))) {
  stop("The analysis cohort is missing a required QoL landmark variable.")
}
if (!all(required_qol %in% names(qol))) {
  stop("The longitudinal QoL dataset lacks dates or Q30 values required for landmark preparation.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(cohort$id)) stop("The analysis cohort must have one row per participant.")
visit_variable <- intersect(c("date_visit", "visit_date"), names(cohort))
if (length(visit_variable) != 1L) {
  stop("The analysis cohort must contain exactly one of `date_visit` or legacy `visit_date`.")
}
cohort$date_visit <- cohort[[visit_variable]]

# Use the same five diagnosis categories in the QoL imputation and analysis
# models: the four most common diagnoses in the full cohort and "Other".
# There are not ties.
diagnosis_label <- as.character(cohort$diagnosis)
diagnosis_counts <- as.data.frame(
  table(diagnosis_label, useNA = "no"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
diagnosis_counts <- diagnosis_counts[order(
  -diagnosis_counts$Freq,
  diagnosis_counts$diagnosis_label
), ]
common_diagnoses <- head(diagnosis_counts$diagnosis_label, 4L)
cohort$diagnosis_group <- ifelse(
  is.na(diagnosis_label),
  NA_character_,
  ifelse(diagnosis_label %in% common_diagnoses, diagnosis_label, "Other")
)
cohort$diagnosis_code <- as.integer(factor(
  cohort$diagnosis_group,
  levels = c(common_diagnoses, "Other")
))

primary_columns <- unique(c(
  required_cohort,
  "diagnosis_group", "diagnosis_code",
  intersect(
    c("plan_fstcnt_coded", "albumin", "c_reactive_protein"),
    names(cohort)
  )
))

baseline <- cohort[c("id", "baseline_q30")]
baseline$baseline_assessment_id <- NA_character_
missing_baseline_ids <- baseline$id[is.na(baseline$baseline_q30)]

baseline_candidates <- merge(
  qol[
    qol$id %in% missing_baseline_ids &
      !is.na(qol$q30) & !is.na(qol$questionnaire_date),
    c(
    "id", "assessment_id", "questionnaire_date", "q30"
    )
  ],
  cohort[c("id", "date_visit")],
  by = "id",
  all = FALSE
)
baseline_candidates$distance_days <- abs(as.integer(
  baseline_candidates$questionnaire_date - baseline_candidates$date_visit
))
baseline_candidates <- baseline_candidates[
  !is.na(baseline_candidates$distance_days) &
    baseline_candidates$distance_days <= 14L,
]
baseline_candidates <- baseline_candidates[order(
  baseline_candidates$id,
  baseline_candidates$distance_days,
  baseline_candidates$questionnaire_date,
  baseline_candidates$assessment_id
), ]
fallback_baseline <- baseline_candidates[
  !duplicated(baseline_candidates$id),
  c(
  "id", "assessment_id", "q30"
  )
]
names(fallback_baseline)[names(fallback_baseline) == "assessment_id"] <-
  "baseline_assessment_id"
names(fallback_baseline)[names(fallback_baseline) == "q30"] <- "baseline_q30"
fallback_rows <- match(fallback_baseline$id, baseline$id)
matched_fallback <- !is.na(fallback_rows)
fallback_baseline <- fallback_baseline[matched_fallback, ]
fallback_rows <- fallback_rows[matched_fallback]
baseline$baseline_q30[fallback_rows] <- fallback_baseline$baseline_q30
baseline$baseline_assessment_id[fallback_rows] <-
  fallback_baseline$baseline_assessment_id

valid_qol <- qol[
  !is.na(qol$q30) & qol$day > 0 & qol$day <= config$analysis$horizon_days,
  c("id", "assessment_id", "day", "q30")
]
baseline_ids <- baseline$baseline_assessment_id[match(valid_qol$id, baseline$id)]
valid_qol <- valid_qol[
  is.na(baseline_ids) | valid_qol$assessment_id != baseline_ids,
]
valid_qol <- valid_qol[order(valid_qol$id, valid_qol$day), ]
latest <- valid_qol[!duplicated(valid_qol$id, fromLast = TRUE), ]
latest$assessment_id <- NULL
names(latest)[names(latest) == "day"] <- "landmark_day"
names(latest)[names(latest) == "q30"] <- "landmark_q30"

cohort_primary <- cohort[primary_columns]
cohort_primary$baseline_q30 <- baseline$baseline_q30[
  match(cohort_primary$id, baseline$id)
]
cohort_primary$baseline_assessment_id <- baseline$baseline_assessment_id[
  match(cohort_primary$id, baseline$id)
]
prepared <- merge(
  cohort_primary,
  latest,
  by = "id",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)
prepared <- prepared[match(cohort$id, prepared$id), ]
prepared$baseline_q30 <- ifelse(
  is.na(prepared$baseline_q30),
  NA_integer_,
  as.integer(prepared$baseline_q30)
)
prepared$y_landmark <- ifelse(
  prepared$event_death == 1L,
  8L,
  ifelse(
    prepared$survival_time_days < config$analysis$horizon_days |
      is.na(prepared$landmark_q30),
    NA_integer_,
    as.integer(prepared$landmark_q30)
  )
)

if (any(!is.na(prepared$baseline_q30) & !prepared$baseline_q30 %in% 1:7)) {
  stop("Baseline Q30 produced a QoL state outside 1:7.")
}
if (any(!is.na(prepared$y_landmark) & !prepared$y_landmark %in% 1:8)) {
  stop("The six-month QoL endpoint contains a state outside 1:8.")
}
if (any(prepared$event_death == 1L & prepared$y_landmark != 8L)) {
  stop("Every death by day 182 must be assigned the absorbing death state.")
}

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
arrow::write_parquet(prepared, output_path, compression = "zstd")

# Supporting death-inclusive longitudinal data: QoL is missing only while a
# participant is known alive. Rows after non-death censoring are absent; death
# is retained as an absorbing state through week 26.
long_columns <- intersect(
  c(
    "id", "tx", "age", "gender", "diagnosis_code", "ecog_fstcnt",
    "plan_fstcnt_coded", "albumin", "c_reactive_protein",
    "event_death", "survival_time_days"
  ),
  names(cohort)
)
long_base <- cohort[long_columns]
long_base <- merge(
  long_base,
  baseline[c("id", "baseline_q30")],
  by = "id",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)
long_grid <- merge(long_base, data.frame(week = 1:26), by = NULL)
weekly_qol <- qol[
  !is.na(qol$q30) & qol$day > 0 & qol$day <= config$analysis$horizon_days,
  c("id", "assessment_id", "day", "q30")
]
weekly_baseline_ids <- baseline$baseline_assessment_id[
  match(weekly_qol$id, baseline$id)
]
weekly_qol <- weekly_qol[
  is.na(weekly_baseline_ids) | weekly_qol$assessment_id != weekly_baseline_ids,
]
weekly_qol$week <- pmax(1L, pmin(26L, ceiling(weekly_qol$day / 7)))
weekly_qol <- weekly_qol[order(weekly_qol$id, weekly_qol$week, weekly_qol$day), ]
weekly_qol <- weekly_qol[
  !duplicated(weekly_qol[c("id", "week")], fromLast = TRUE),
  c("id", "week", "q30")
]
long_grid <- merge(
  long_grid,
  weekly_qol,
  by = c("id", "week"),
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)
long_grid$death_week <- ifelse(
  long_grid$event_death == 1L,
  pmax(1L, pmin(26L, ceiling(long_grid$survival_time_days / 7))),
  NA_integer_
)
known_alive <- long_grid$week * 7 <= long_grid$survival_time_days |
  !is.na(long_grid$q30)
after_death <- long_grid$event_death == 1L &
  long_grid$week >= long_grid$death_week
long_grid <- long_grid[known_alive | after_death, ]
long_grid$y_death_inclusive <- ifelse(
  long_grid$event_death == 1L & long_grid$week >= long_grid$death_week,
  8L,
  ifelse(is.na(long_grid$q30), NA_integer_, as.integer(long_grid$q30))
)
long_grid <- long_grid[order(long_grid$id, long_grid$week), ]
arrow::write_parquet(long_grid, longitudinal_path, compression = "zstd")
```
